title: Table of contents heading ids collide or overwrite existing ids
body:
Bugs seen in mistune: (1) With escape=False and the fenced toc directive, a document that already contains
and
before a '# title' heading gets a heading id that collides with them; the heading should get the next free id, 'toc_1_2', and the toc link should point to it. (2) A before-render hook that sets token['attrs']['id'] = 'existing' on headings is overwritten by the toc: the heading must keep id 'existing', the toc link must be href="#existing", and no generated 'toc_1' appears. This holds both for the directive and for add_toc_hook used alone. (3) Two toc sections in one document must still share the same heading ids.

acceptance.verify: PYTHONPATH=src mise exec pipx:pytest@9.2.0 -- pytest -q tests
